description: Synthetic retrieval cases. Relevance labels are explicit human expectations; lexical failures and condition-reversal judgments remain visible rather than being scored as model learning.

records.body: Check retry_queue before changing its dispatcher.
Release established login state independently from secondary fetches.
records.applies_when: An authenticated screen waits for quota telemetry before becoming usable.
records.not_when: The request establishes identity or checks authorization itself.

records.body: Typography uses the rounded display font.
Keep buffered canvas redraw work coalesced.
records.applies_when: High-frequency mouse movement overwhelms canvas paints.

records.body: 프로필을 열기 전에 계정 식별을 확인한다.

cases.request: An authenticated dashboard waits for quota telemetry in BillingPanel.tsx.
cases.applicability_expectation: Relevant through the positive condition despite a different filename; current source must still establish that identity is already verified. The record sorts outside the default first three so an unrelated-slot fallback cannot masquerade as transfer.
The negative condition alone must not make the canvas lesson relevant.
The superseded body's unique identifier must not be an active retrieval signal.
The generic word shared produces a false inclusion; this fixture intentionally retains that limitation.

cases.request: Session bootstrap must finish without waiting for auxiliary metrics.
cases.applicability_expectation: A human sees the relationship, but the query has no indexed lexical overlap. A miss must remain visible; this is not a semantic retriever.
With no query, preserve the existing bounded listing order. This case checks listing compatibility rather than relevance judgment.

cases.request: High-frequency mouse movement overwhelms canvas paints while investigating ethernet negotiation.
cases.applicability_expectation: Retrieval should expose both conditions. A model must recognize the negative condition and withhold the canvas recommendation for the ethernet investigation; this runner does not judge that decision.
